Create a line segment along the Z axis defined by start point and length, optionally reversed or both sides

**Panel:** Comma → Curve · **Nickname:** `LnZ`

## Inputs

| Name | Nickname | Type | Access | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Point | `P` | Point | Item |  | Line start point |
| Length | `L` | Number | Item | `1000.00` | Line length |
| Reverse | `R` | Boolean | Item | `false` | Flip? |
| Slope | `S` | Text | Item | `"0"` | Slope as percentage, fraction, or angle.<br>Support formats:<br> - 2.5%<br> - 4/6<br> - 70 degrees<br> - 30° |
| Vertical | `V` | Vector | Item | `Vector3d.ZAxis` | Vertical slope vector |

## Outputs

| Name | Nickname | Type | Access | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Line | `L` | Line | Item | Line segment |

## Right-click menu

Options in the component's context menu:

- Normal
- BothSides
